THURSDAY - MARCH 9, 2017 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT HELD ON MARCH 9,
2017, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Dustin Parker, Concordia Lutheran Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Girl Scout Troop 1030.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in
  attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  American Red Cross (American Red Cross Awareness Month)

  Vincent Chou (Eagle Scout)

  Cerritos High School Regiment of Gold Marching Band (Western Band
  Association’s 2016 Class 3A State Champions)

  Joshua Perkins – Atlanta Falcons (Cerritos Hometown Hero)

  Dwayne Washington – Detroit Lions (Cerritos Hometown Hero)

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Marlene Rofe spoke regarding the City's tree trimming program.

  Angel Soto spoke regarding City Council term limits.

  Kirit Chauhan invited the community to the 6th Annual Bowling Dons Tournament
  fundraiser on Sunday, March 26, 2017.

  Marty Grossman spoke regarding the fee schedule.

  Gail Grossman spoke regarding proposed spending cuts and the fee schedule.

  Anna Titus expressed concerns regarding neglecting private properties in the
  community. She also invited the community to the upcoming Mayor's Prayer
  Breakfast.

  Sally Havice spoke regarding tree maintenance in the City.
 City of Cerritos  March 9, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 4

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  Jay Gray spoke regarding the recently approved fee schedule and the increase in
  wall height.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  February 23, 2017 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of February 23, 2017
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated March 9, 2017
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated March 9, 2017 in the amount
  of $6,032,849.14 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated March 9, 2017 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment
  Agency dated March 9, 2017 in the amount of $36,124.01 (SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  March 9, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 4

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7D.  Approval of the Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending January 31, 2017
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending January 31, 2017
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational report on the new Hoopla digital
  media service offered by the Cerritos Library (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian and Marketing Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Pulido, to receive and file the
  report (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of an informational report on the Cerritos Park East
  Ballfield refurbishment project (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Sherre Titus, Recreation Services Superintendent.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Gene Luevano thanked the City Council for the ballfield refurbishment project at
  Cerritos Park East.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to receive and file the
  report (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  March 9, 2017

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  Review and consideration of an informational report to the City Council
  regarding the status of previously approved development projects (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Torrey Contreras, Community Development Director,
  and Sandy Cisneros, Senior Planner.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Edwards, to receive and file the
  report (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Chen, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Pulido, Chen, and Edwards, Mayor
  Pro Tem Solanki, and Mayor Ray.

  CONSENSUS (Ray): Directed staff to bring back a report on the impact of the
  recent storms, the impact on the City, and the City’s response.

  CONSENSUS (Ray): Directed staff to bring back a report on the legal options
  regarding beautification of certain properties throughout the City including the
  property located at the northwest corner of South Street and Carmenita.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:09 p.m.
